'''Solar Wind Seven''' was the callsign of an unknown [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] flying a [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wing]] during the [[Battle of Adumar]] in [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]]. The pilot was ordered by [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] to join the screen against the [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defenders]] protecting the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] capital ships.<ref name="soa">''[[X-Wing: Starfighters of Adumar]]''</ref>
